During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces staged an '''attack''' on [[Ort Hoogra-D'En]]'s [[Ort Hoogra-D'En's base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pallaxides]]. The assault was in retaliation for Hoogra-D'en's [[Bombing of Syndaar Military Prep School|bombing]] of the [[Syndaar Military Prep School]].<ref name="GTG" />
